episodes.title: I Am the Shadows
episodes.break_rationale: Ends as Batman and Gordon discover the cipher left inside Mayor Mitchell's car, exposing the Iceberg Lounge connection.
episodes.recap_text: On Halloween night, Mayor Don Mitchell Jr. is murdered by the Riddler. Batman pairs with Lt. Jim Gordon to investigate cryptic greeting cards left addressed to 'The Batman'.
episodes.teaser_next: A trip into Oswald Cobblepot's Iceberg Lounge uncovers a web of police payoffs and an enigmatic cat burglar named Selina Kyle.

episodes.title: The Sins of the Father
episodes.break_rationale: High-octane highway Batmobile pursuit ends with Penguin captured in flames, followed by Riddler's terrifying bomb attack at Mitchell's funeral.
episodes.recap_text: Batman infiltrates the 44 Below underworld club, partners with Selina Kyle, and engages in a ferocious car chase through rush-hour rain to capture the Penguin.
episodes.teaser_next: District Attorney Gil Colson drives a bomb into the cathedral funeral with a collar locked around his neck.

episodes.title: A Flood of Lies
episodes.break_rationale: The Riddler is apprehended at a diner, but his final phase—seven bomb-laden vans parked around Gotham's seawall—is armed.
episodes.recap_text: Colson dies refusing to name the informant. Carmine Falcone is unmasked as the city's true kingpin, only to be assassinated from the shadows by Edward Nashton.
episodes.teaser_next: The sea walls shatter. Water rushes into Gotham City while sniper disciples take aim at the crowded shelter.

episodes.title: A Flare in the Dark
episodes.break_rationale: Climactic rescue of the submerged citizens under the arena dome, followed by Batman's transformation from vengeance into hope.
episodes.recap_text: Batman leads stranded citizens out of the flooded arena with a crimson rescue flare, choosing to become a beacon of hope rather than mere vengeance.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the gritty noir detective miniseries.
